baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural mountains (ج ب ل) are the passive subject of نُسِفَتْ (ن س ف).
baseline_models.mechanism: A high solid landmark is uprooted and stripped from its place. The passive construction foregrounds the loss of emplacement and integrity rather than the acting agent.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies the focus object as a maximally fixed terrestrial landmark.
Uprooting and removal from place supplies the event that cancels the landmark's fixed location.

changed_reading.after: The mountains are stripped from their seats: what seemed maximally fixed loses both location and coherence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The solid mass of ٱلْجِبَالُ is paired with the sieve and flying-residue branches of نُسِفَتْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mountain mass is agitated as material in a sieve, differentiated, and reduced from a coherent body to airborne residue. This is a process of granularization rather than an instantaneous disappearance.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies the initially coherent material being processed.
Shaking and sifting supplies the separating operation applied to that coherent mass.
Scattered chaff, dust, or foam supplies the airborne output state of the operation.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are removed as intact objects.
changed_reading.after: Their solidity is processed away: the mass is shaken apart and leaves flying residue rather than merely changing location.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The blocking-hardness branches of ج ب ل are reversed by the removal branch of ن س ف.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mountain is not only mass but a hard stop that prevents penetration and passage. Uprooting it revokes the world's most emphatic obstruction and turns blocked terrain into exposed access.

activation_trace.role: Hardness that stops digging supplies the mountain as an impassable material limit.
Difficulty and prevention broadens the hard stop into a functional barrier.
Removal from place supplies the reversal by which the barrier ceases to block.

changed_reading.before: The verse changes the appearance of the terrain.
changed_reading.after: The verse abolishes the terrain's hard stop, exposing what mountain solidity had made inaccessible or protected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies a material chain: severe wind lightens and scatters, spreading opens the material out, and separation breaks it into parts. That chain turns the focus's sieve branch into a whole operation of mountain winnowing.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies the unusually resistant input to the winnowing chain.
Sieve-like shaking supplies the focus operation that the context expands into stages.
Flying chaff or dust supplies the resulting state after the staged operation.
A severe wind that makes things light and scatters them supplies the driving force.
Opening, spreading, and branching supplies the expansion stage after loosening.
Scattering into parts supplies the terminal separation stage.

structural_cues: 77:2-4 forms a repeated participle-plus-cognate-accusative sequence immediately before the reminder and promised event.
The ordered verbs move from force to extension to division, matching successive phases of material winnowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wind, spreading, separation, sieve, and residue images; I infer that they can be read as stages of one process applied to the mountains. A live alternative is that 77:2-4 names distinct oath agents or effects and does not causally explain 77:10.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are uprooted in one destructive act.
changed_reading.after: They are winnowed: force loosens them, spreading exposes their material, and separation reduces the solid mass to airborne residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Erasing celestial marks, opening the overhead enclosure, removing terrestrial anchors, and assigning the messengers a time form a coordinated shutdown. Mountain removal becomes the ground-level hinge between cosmic opening and timed testimony.

activation_trace.role: The high solid landmark supplies the terrestrial anchor decommissioned in the middle of the sequence.
Uprooting and removal supplies the ground-clearing operation.
Erasure of a trace supplies the preceding removal of celestial marks.
The opening of a gap supplies the preceding breach of the overhead enclosure.
Defining by a time or limit supplies the following transition from dismantling to scheduled testimony.

structural_cues: 77:8-11 consists of four coordinated conditional clauses: stars erased, sky opened, mountains uprooted, and messengers timed.
77:12-14 resolves the sequence toward the day of separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent إذا clauses and branch images of erasure, opening, removal, and timing; I infer one ordered decommissioning sequence. They may instead be independent signs listed without a process relation.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated image of geological destruction.
changed_reading.after: It is a scheduled clearing operation in a cosmic shutdown: terrestrial anchors are removed after the sky opens and before testimony is convened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later creation panel constructs a stable habitat: material is made into a state, placed in stability, gathered by the earth, and furnished with fixed lofty anchors. The focus reverses that architecture by removing the anchors from their emplacement.

activation_trace.role: The solid earth-peg or landmark supplies the focus component of the habitat's stability system.
Removal from place supplies the exact reversal of emplacement and anchoring.
Making something into a state supplies deliberate construction of the fixed mountains.
Fixity and settlement supplies the panel's initial logic of secure emplacement.
Gathering and holding in a container supplies the earth's encompassing function.
Fixity and rooted stability explicitly identifies the mountains as anchors.
Mountain height rising into the sky supplies the anchors' visible vertical prominence.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 moves from weak fluid through secure placement and measured formation to an earth that contains life and death, fixed mountains, and fresh water.
The refrain after 77:27 closes a creation panel that re-presents the focus object in its stabilizing state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies making, settlement, containment, fixedness, height, and focus removal; I infer that 77:10 reverses the habitat architecture displayed in 77:20-27. A live alternative is that 77:27 recalls present beneficence without defining the function undone at 77:10.

changed_reading.before: The catastrophe erases one large feature of the landscape.
changed_reading.after: It deliberately decommissions the made system of containment and anchoring by unseating the very features later named as fixed and lofty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sieve image acquires a juridical analogue: excuses become unavailable, the day separates truth from falsehood, deniers recur as the named class, and speech is withheld. Material disaggregation at the focus becomes a visible model for adjudicative sorting.

activation_trace.role: Sifting that separates good from bad supplies the focus's material sorting operation.
Excuse and exculpation supplies the defense that the scene explicitly prevents.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the legal counterpart to material sifting.
Contradiction of truth supplies the repeatedly identified claim-position subjected to judgment.
Speech supplies the faculty withheld immediately before excuses are denied.

structural_cues: The denier refrain recurs after each scene, while 77:13 and 77:38 name the day of separation and 77:35-36 withholds speech and excuse.
The focus lies before the first explicit naming of that day, so the material separation can prepare its adjudicative register.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sieve separation and a legal sequence of truth, denial, speech, and excuse; I map the material operation onto adjudication. The live alternative is that mountain sifting remains wholly physical while the judicial sequence is only thematic parallelism.

changed_reading.before: Sifting describes only what happens to mountain material.
changed_reading.after: The mountain event also stages the surah's adjudicative logic: apparently solid positions are broken open so truth and falsehood can no longer remain mixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mountains can be entered and function as hard barriers, making them potential topographic shelter. Their removal strips that assumed defense; the later paired shade scenes distinguish a false cover that cannot protect from an effective shade associated with protection.

activation_trace.role: Entering the mountains supplies the focus object as a place one might occupy for refuge.
Difficulty and prevention supplies the mountain's defensive barrier function.
Removal from place supplies the loss of that topographic defense.
Shelter and protection supplies the expected function that 77:31 immediately negates for this shade.
Shelter and protection returns as the effective cover assigned to the protected.
Warding harm through protection identifies the group for whom shade is effective.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 orders deniers toward a three-branched shade and then denies both shade and protection, whereas 77:41 places the protected in shades.
The two shade scenes reverse the same shelter image across condemned and protected groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mountain entry and blockage, focus removal, false shade, true shade, and protection; I infer that the removed mountain activates loss of assumed refuge and redistribution of shelter. Mountains may instead be only terrain here, with no refuge function intended.

changed_reading.before: Removing the mountains only clears terrain.
changed_reading.after: It also revokes presumed topographic protection, preparing a world in which cover is tested as false or effective rather than guaranteed by massive barriers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's flying residue is activated by a later chain of throwing, airborne sparks, and building- or camel-scale comparison. Solid mass does not simply vanish; conceptually, it changes from fixed landmark into dangerous mobile matter.

activation_trace.role: The high solid mass supplies the immobile starting state whose scale remains conceptually available.
Scattered chaff or dust supplies the conversion from fixed mass to airborne matter.
Sending or throwing supplies directed motion to the later airborne material.
Flying fire-sparks supply a dangerous airborne counterpart to the focus residue.
The enclosed building supplies massive constructed scale to what is being thrown.
Great bodily size and camel likeness supplies a second mass-scale comparison for the moving sparks.

structural_cues: 77:32-33 is a continuous motion-and-simile chain: it throws sparks, then scales their appearance through a building and camel-like mass.
The later chain reverses the focus contrast between immense fixed input and dispersed airborne output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flying focus residue and later thrown sparks with massive similes; I infer a shared material logic in which fixed scale becomes mobile danger. The live alternative is that the fire scene is independent and its comparisons do not refer back to mountain matter.

changed_reading.before: The mountain mass disperses and ceases to matter.
changed_reading.after: Dispersal is a change of mobility rather than simple absence: immense fixed matter becomes an imaginative precursor to immense matter moving through the air.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from geology into bodily and social posture and activates the chiefs-like-mountains branch. It remains anchored in the focus's high mass and forced removal, sharpened by the packet's raised-nose and lowered-head images. Downstream prose should present it only as a vertical-moral echo, not as a replacement for literal mountains.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The high or chiefly mountain image is forcibly unseated in نُسِفَتْ, while later people refuse the commanded lowering of the head.

activation_trace.role: High solid mass supplies the vertical posture that the focus forcibly reverses.
Chiefs likened to mountains permits a contained transfer from physical elevation to social elevation.
Uprooting supplies involuntary loss of the elevated position.
Raising the nose in pride supplies the social-postural form of elevation.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the voluntary vertical reversal that is refused.
Humility supplies the moral posture contrasted with involuntary unseating.

changed_reading.before: Only mountains are made to lose height and position.
changed_reading.after: The mountains enact involuntary lowering, forming a contained mirror for elevated people who refuse to lower themselves voluntarily.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-supported but form-distant: the focus noun ordinarily denotes concrete mountains, while its inventory also carries great multitudes and mountain-like chiefs. The first/later destruction and final gathering make the social mechanism live, but downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy of entrenched collectives or authority, never as the sole lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural جِبَال can carry mountain-like abundance or chiefs, and نُسِفَتْ supplies their dislodgment.

activation_trace.role: Mountain-like abundance supplies the possible image of a massive human collective.
Chiefs like mountains supplies the possible entrenched leadership of that collective.
Uprooting and removal supplies dislodgment of the collective or its authority.
Falling into destruction supplies removal of the first human cohort.
Succession and sequence supplies the later cohort following the first.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies the final assembly of cohorts after entrenched forms are removed.

changed_reading.before: The focus removes only geological masses.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social analogy, it can also picture entrenched multitudes and mountain-like chiefs dislodged before first and later peoples are gathered together.

strongest_changes: The wind-spread-separate sequence in 77:2-4 turns ن س ف from generic destruction into a staged winnowing of solid mass.
The coordinated clauses in 77:8-11 place mountain removal inside an ordered cosmic decommissioning before timed testimony.
The creation panel in 77:20-27 re-presents mountains as made, fixed, lofty anchors, so 77:10 becomes a reversal of habitat stability.
The day-of-separation and no-excuse sequence gives the sieve branch a qualified adjudicative analogue.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet connected the focus's rare material verb both backward to wind, spreading, and separation and forward to recreated stability, contested shelter, judgment, and airborne scale. This produced several changed readings without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening oath sequence may be parallel rather than causally continuous, so the winnowing chain remains an inferred arrow.
The juridical and refuge readings depend on functional analogy beyond the literal geological event.
The mobile-matter, involuntary-bowing, and uprooted-collective readings are branch-anchored echoes whose intended status remains exploratory.
